selection_objective: direct Jev Overall edit question from the prior review
development_scope: previously exposed 4-case alpha screen and eight-case review

pair_rubric.state: Image_1 is the original with the slider off. Image_2 and image_3 are anonymized candidate edits of that original. A successful edit turns the original subject into a convincing Final Boss through the character design, preserves the identity, background, lighting and framing, and remains a coherent finished image.

preference.instructions: Which candidate is the better edit of image_1 overall? Judge character transformation and preservation together. Use the middle choice when the tradeoff makes them equally good.

active_score.primary: mean per-case Final Boss effect adjusted for visible breakage
active_score.effect: nonnegative matched ON minus OFF Boss distinction

boss_distinction_rubric.state: Image_1 is the original illustration. Image_2 is the edited illustration. Judge whether the edited person has become an unmistakable climactic video-game antagonist, from visible design of the character alone.

boss_distinction.instructions: Score Final Boss distinction from 0 to 1. 0 means no discernible boss character. 0.25 means ordinary clothing, generic armor, or a stern face alone. 0.50 means a credible elite warrior or rival, with some boss cues. 0.75 means a distinctive endgame antagonist with a recognizable, purposeful silhouette and signature character details. 1.0 means a visually unmistakable final encounter character. Reward commanding presence built into the character design. Judge the outfit, silhouette, headpiece, insignia, and other visible evidence. Ignore scene, lighting, crop, and image polish.

effect_pair_rubric.state: Image_1 is the shared original. Image_2 and image_3 are two candidate edits of that original. Judge Final Boss effect from each edited character's visual design. A distinctive climactic antagonist has purposefully designed costume or gear, a recognizable silhouette, and commanding presence built into the character. Use only evidence on the character.

preference.instructions: Which edit more clearly transforms the original character into an unmistakable Final Boss? Compare visual character design and choose the middle position when the two effects are equivalent.

previous_effect_score.primary: mean matched ON minus OFF Boss distinction

experiment_target: Twelve distinct Final Boss vibe scenes; shared RAW192 and the pinned eight-case score.
